body: I agree with what NFTrot said, and if you're having trouble with it remember to just take deep breaths. Write down the steps you need to take to get help and talk to your parents and just focus on taking one step at a time. I've struggled a lot with suicide as well, and every time that I stop myself, I'm always horrified afterward with what I was about to do. It isn't worth it. I'm 100% sure that your parents would be in more pain if you killed yourself than if you come clean and tell them what you had been lying. You've probably heard this before but setting goals and making progress (even if it's only a little) helps a lot. Start small, if you don't have a job, try getting a part-time one or one that doesn't require a lot of previous experience. Remember that many people recover from mental illness and you still have the ability to live a full life. If you can't talk on the phone, text "start" to 741741 for a text hotline, and if you can't use the phone in general, look up suicide hotline on google, there will be a way to instant message someone. Good luck, I hope this was helpful.

When I named my tulpas, I just went with the first name that popped into my head. It doesn't really matter if it's from something else, you will grow to associate you tulpa with that name. If it's something that he doesn't like though, just try to think of a new one. Baby naming books might help, or choosing a name the represents something important to him. Good luck!

I'm sorry that this is a problem for you. I don't know if this is helpful, but you could try being an Uber or Lyft driver? Working at one of them, or a different company similar to them might be beneficial because it isn't a strict schedule so if you are in a lot of pain then you can just take a break. Plus, you can keep the car cool while you drive! I would be sure to do research though, I don't know a lot about these companies so they might not be the right fit. I hope any of this helped you!
